about: One adversarial table for where a managed-site link may point, ported from megaseo-web
and its TypeScript twin src/util/cms_link_rules.ts) and run here by site-starter packages/managed-site-contract
(the contract Site Guard parses and a site builds against).
Keep this file byte-identical wherever it is run; change every copy together.
Each case's constraints are shallow-merged over the named base.
reason is the CMS's refusal reason; the contract package reports its own error and is held to outcome only.
pageId is the page every internal case names; a CMS runner must declare it once in the contract's pages.
Every destination a declared base admits, its any_https counterpart (link_open, rich_open) admits too: switching a field from a declared list of DNS names to any_https is a true widening.
destinationCases: a link field value (label 'Read more', target same_window) or a rich-text link mark (target same_window).
policyCases: whether the field's constraints parse; the CMS refuses a rejected policy as 'link policy is invalid'.
labelCases: a link field label under link_open with labelConstraints.newlines set as stated.
contractOnly: a verdict the CMS has no counterpart for, with why.
